component.summary: Fill in, sign and redact PDF forms
Remplir, signer et caviarder des formulaires PDF
Remplir, signer et caviarder des formulaires PDF

description.p: MegaPDF does the one job most people actually have with a PDF: someone sent you a form, and you need to send it back filled in, checked off and signed. No account, no subscription, no cloud. Everything happens on your own computer.

ul.li: Tick any box — real form fields and plain printed squares alike, including drawn checkboxes other applications treat as decoration.
Type on any line, in the size and face that matches the form. What you add is real, searchable text, not a sticker on top of the page.
Sign by drawing, or from a photograph of a signature on paper — the white background disappears. Signatures stay in a library on your own computer.
Search the whole document as you type, with every match counted.
Print through your desktop's own print dialogue.

description.p: Changing what is already on the page:

ul.li: Correct the document's own text. MegaPDF keeps the document's font when that font can draw everything you typed, and tells you when it had to use a similar one. If a change would disturb the rest of the page, it asks first rather than quietly moving things.
Redact: mark text or a picture, and MegaPDF removes it from the file. Whiteout covers rather than removes, and says so.
Open a protected PDF with its password, and set, change or remove one. Where the owner restricted what may be changed, MegaPDF honours that and says why.

description.p: Very large documents open straight away: MegaPDF reads a file as it needs it rather than loading the whole thing, so a 2.5 GB document of a thousand pages opens in milliseconds instead of a minute, and in megabytes instead of gigabytes.
Nothing is lost. Every document is verified before your original is touched, so a failed save cannot corrupt the file someone sent you, and closing or quitting with unsaved changes always asks first.

MegaPDF makes no network connection, and this package asks for no network permission — so that is a fact about the package rather than a claim in a listing. It asks for no access to your files either: opening and saving go through the desktop's file portal, which hands the application exactly the file you picked and nothing else. Your documents and your signature never leave your computer, because there is no server for them to go to.
The interface is in English and French. MegaPDF is free software under the Apache License 2.0, so anyone can check any of the above.

description.p: The first MegaPDF release for Linux. It brings everything in 2.0:

ul.li: Correcting the document's own text far more often. Over a 22,000-edit test run, every one of the 112 edits 1.7 used to refuse now goes through, and none of them disturbs the page.
Redaction: mark text or a picture and MegaPDF removes it from the file. Whiteout only covers, and now says so.
Protected PDFs: open one with its password, and set, change or remove a password. Where the owner restricted what may be changed, MegaPDF respects that and says so.

Very large PDFs. A 2.5 GB file used to take a minute to open and gigabytes of memory; it now opens straight away. Banner-size pages measure at their real size, and pages full of pictures draw several times faster.
One row of tools, with the pickers appearing beside the tool they belong to and everything else under More.

It tells you what it is doing: opening, saving, checking the saved file, searching, checking a page, making a smaller copy, preparing to print. Anything quicker than half a second still says nothing at all.
Your work is safer. Closing, quitting or opening another file with unsaved changes always asks first, and a save that fails can no longer leave the original empty.
